headline: UK Retailer Next Discloses Third-Party Supplier Data Breach
summary: Clothing retailer Next warned that hackers accessed company data through a technology supplier. Next stated that no personal customer data capable of enabling fraud was compromised.
why: Next plc is a major British multinational clothing and home product retailer operating more than 800 stores across the UK and Ireland.

impacts.name: Next plc
impacts.why: Next warned that benign company data was accessed via a hack of a third-party supplier.
